g.id: Collect inputs: dam design, terrain, floods, downstream assets
Screen the failure modes of the RCC gravity dam: monolith sliding
Define scenarios: sunny day, flood day, PMF without failure
Set breach parameters: base, lower and upper cases
Build the HEC-RAS 2D model: reservoir, dam, wadi to the sea
Run the scenarios and the sensitivity cases
Check: solver finish, mass balance, peak against the hand bounds
Map depth, velocity, arrival time and hazard class
Count people and plots at risk, per hazard class
Classify the dam, report, feed the emergency action plan
